Kurs xaritasi va ushbu hujjatdan qanday foydalanish
Ushbu hujjat — Toshkent texnologiya universitetidagi «English for Engineering – I»
asosiy (Foundation) kursining 5–7-haftalari bo’yicha to’liq, o’z-o’zicha yetarli yor-
damchi qo’llanma (2026-yil kuz semestri, 4 ECTS; modul koordinatorlari Ella Tsoy
va Florence Dujarric, Energetika muhandisligi fakulteti).
Modul barcha bakalavr
yo’nalishlari uchun majburiy — 60 soat auditoriya mashg’uloti (30 soat ma’ruza +30
soat amaliy) va ustiga qo’shimcha 60 soat mustaqil ta’lim, oldindan talab qilinadigan
yoki parallel o’qiladigan fanlar yo’q — va u Foundation bosqichi talabalarini umu-
miy maktab ingliz tilidan ishonchli, aniq va tartibli kundalik hamda akademik mu-
loqotga o’tishga tayyorlaydi.
Ushbu qo’llanma blok bo’yicha tegishli barcha kurs
fayllaridan qo’lda tayyorlandi: 5-, 6- va 7-haftalar ma’ruza materiallari hamda 5-
hafta grammatika ish varag’i (passiv va uning qo’llanilishi). 5–6-haftalar fayllari OCR
yordamida matnga o’tkazilgan rasmli skanerlar bo’lib, ayon skanerlash nuqsonlari
tozalandi; biroq o’sha manbalarda uchraydigan har bir savol, bo’sh joy to’ldirish,
moslashtirish topshiriqi, ta’rif va munozara savoli so’zma-so’z keltirilgan, va har bir
mashqdan so’ng to’liq javob kaliti berilgan. Sillabusning baholash jadvaliga ko’ra,
ushbu blokni qamrab oluvchi Test 2 — qog’ozda bajariladigan yozma ish (1 soat, 10
%), shuning uchun quyidagi grammatika kataloglari eng batafsil yoritilgan.
Qamrov rasmiy kurs tuzilmasiga amal qiladi. 5-hafta blokni Describing Processes
and Sequences (jarayonlar va ketma-ketliklarni tasvirlash) mavzusi bilan ochadi:
grammatika yo’nalishi — passiv (barcha zamonlar); u «The solution to our energy
problems. . . isa toaster» TED suhbati orqali oldindan ko’rsatiladi; so’ngra ma’ruza
ishlab chiqarish jarayonlari lug’ati (drilling, casting, welding. . .), «How Is Tea Made?»
o’qish matni hamda quyosh radiatsiyasi matni va uning ketma-ketlik tiliga quril-
gan jarayon tasvirlash yo’nalishi ustida ishlaydi.
6-hafta Understanding Graphs
and Short Talks (grafiklar va qisqa nutqlarni tushunish) mavzusiga o’tadi: og’zaki
bayon yo’nalishi oddiy grafik va diagrammalarni tasvirlashni (diagramma turlari,
harakat fe’llari va otlari, sifat–ravish juftlari) mashq qildiradi; ma’ruza sabab-oqibat
tilini hamda qisqa nutqlarning tuzilishi va yo’naltiruvchi iboralari (signposting)
bo’yicha tinglash yo’nalishini qo’shadi, bundan tashqari «How to Spot a Mislead-
ing Graph» TED suhbati ham mavjud. 7-hafta blokni Comparing Solutions (yechim-
larni taqqoslash) mavzusi bilan yakunlaydi: grammatika yo’nalishi — ot yasalishi: u
«Virtually Fluent» so’z yasalishi videosi bilan tanishtiriladi va suffikslar, prefikslar,
so’z ildizlari, qo’shma otlar hamda konversiya orqali ishlanadi; undan keyin o’qishni
tushunish va Switch Games og’zaki bayon mashg’uloti keladi.
Ushbu hujjatning har bir haftalik qismi bir xil ichki tuzilishga ega. Avval qoidalar
katalogi keladi: hafta manbalarida o’rgatiladigan har bir qoida, shakl jadvali va til
qutisi rasmiy tarzda yozib chiqilgan va uzluksiz raqamlangan, shu sababli istalgan
qoidani javob kalitlaridan iqtibos keltirish mumkin. So’ngra savollar va topshiriqlar
keladi: ular manba fayllarida uchragan tartibda guruhlangan, har biri o’z manbasi
bilan belgilangan va darhol to’liq javob kaliti bilan keltiriladi.
Tinglash va video
mashg’ulotlari o’z topshiriqlari bilan ko’chirilgan; agar javob faqat sinfda o’tirgan
talabalar ko’ra oladigan yozuv yoki rasm sahifasiga bog’liq bo’lsa, kalit kutilayotgan
javob turini va eng ehtimoliy to’ldirish variantini ko’rsatadi, shunda mashqni baribir
tekshirish mumkin. Oxiridagi ilova tezkor ma’lumot materiallarini to’playdi — passiv
bo’yicha tezkor ma’lumotnoma, fe’l+ predlog naqshlaridan iborat grafik tili banki, ot
yasalishi jadvali va o’nta bir qatorli takrorlash javobi — shu tariqa bu yerdagi savollar
banki «oxirigacha» to’liq bo’ladi.

5-hafta uchun grammatika katalogi

(ew5gw.txt), «the passive and its uses» qoidalar sahifasi]
5-haftada bitta grammatika bloki bor: passiv — kursning jarayon va ketma-ketliklarni
tasvirlash uchun zarur bo’lgan barcha zamonlarda.
Quyidagi qoidalar 5-hafta
ma’ruzasining til reference paneli va 5-hafta grammatika ish varag’ining to’liq
qoidalar sahifasini to’playdi; har bir misol o’sha ikki fayldan iqtibos keltirilgan.
• Shakl. Passiv (be+ past participle) ko’pincha harakatni kim bajargani aytilma-
gan, ma’lum emas yoki muhim
bo’lmaganda ishlatiladi: A lot of films are shot on location. The director died when
the film was being made. When is our car being repaired? You’ll be picked up at
the airport by one of our staff. This bill must be paid tomorrow. I love being given a
massage. The new concert hall will be opened by the King. Passiv gaplarda fe’lning
to’ldiruvchisi yangi egaga aylanadi: Artem’s bike has been stolen. (= somebody has
stolen Artem’s bike, but we don’t know who.)
• Passivning qo’llanilishi (ish varag’ining qoidalar sahifasi). Passivni (a) muhim
ma’lumotni —
aktiv gapning to’ldiruvchisini — gap boshiga ko’chirish uchun ishlating: Two men are
being questioned by the police.; (b) shaxssiz bo’lish va harakatni bajaruvchi shaxs-
ning ismini tilga olmaslik uchun

neath the ground or sea; (c) harakatni kim bajargani ayon bo’lganda (masalan,

Aztec boys were trained to fight. Two missing children have been found safe
and well.; (d) kundalik nutqdan ko’ra ko’proq rasmiy nutq va yozuvda.
• Vositachi by.
Harakatni kim bajarganini aytmoqchi bo’lsak, by ni ishlatamiz
(ma’ruza). by ni «agent»ni yoki harakatni
bajargan shaxsni bilish muhim bo’lganda ishlatamiz — Some countries have been
harmed by tourism. Many buildings in the city have been damaged by the earth-
quake. — va faqat chinidan zarur bo’lgandagina: The two men were arrested. (by
the police — this is obvious).
• Aktiv yoki passiv — fokusning ikki usuli.
Bir gapni ko’pincha ikki xil usulda
aytish mumkin: aktiv yoki
passiv shaklda. Taqqoslang: Napoleon was directed by Ridley Scott. (= we want to
focus more on the film) / Ridley Scott directed Napoleon. (= we want to focus more
on the director).
• Inkor va so’roq gaplar aktiv gaplardagi kabi bir xil usulda yasaladi: Some films
aren’t shot
on location. Is your car being repaired today?
• Hozirgi zamondagi oddiy passiv (Present simple passive): am/is/are+ past par-
ticiple (umumiy holda rost bo’lgan jarayonlar uchun): Oil
and gas are found beneath the ground or sea. This room isn’t used very often. O’tgan
zamondagi oddiy passiv (Past simple passive): was/were + past participle (tugallan-
gan voqealar uchun): The college was built in the 16th century. Aztec boys were
trained to fight.
• O’tishli va o’tishsiz fe’llar. To’ldiruvchisi bor fe’llar o’tishli fe’llar deb ataladi;
to’ldiruvchisi
yo’q fe’llar o’tishsiz deyiladi. Faqat o’tishli fe’llar passivga aylantirilishi mumkin: I
lost my wallet on the way to school. (transitive) / I swim every day. (intransitive).
• Predlog with.
Harakatni bajaradigan buyumlar uchun with ni ishlating: The
game was played with a
ball of solid rubber.
• Fan va muhandislikda passiv. Jarayonlar haqida gapirishda passivni ko’p ish-
latamiz,
chunki jarayon bosqichlari ularni bajargan shaxsdan muhimroq: ma’ruzadagi ishlab
chiqarish tavsiflari hammasi passivda — A hole is made using a drill. A material is
pressed into the correct shape. Hot liquid material is poured into a container and
cooled. . . — va xuddi shu naqsh haftaning ilmiy matni orqali ham o’tadi: Around 25%
is then reflected by the upper atmosphere and clouds. . . Finally, 50% is absorbed by
the Earth’s surface.

5-hafta ma’ruzasi, 1-qism: Grammatika — Passiv — savollar va
javoblar
[Manba: 5-hafta ma’ruzasi (ew5lec.txt), 1–5-sahifalar — kirish, TED suhbatini oldindan ko’rish, tezkor
tekshiruv, asosiy mazmunni tinglash, Language
Reference, 1–2-mashqlar]
2.2.1 Oldindan ko’rish mashqlari — TED suhbati «The solution to our energy
problems. . . isa toaster»
Tinglashdan oldin ma’ruza suhbatning asosiy lug’atini uchta panelda ko’rsatib be-
radi. Har bir atamani uning ta’rifi va suhbatda qo’llanilish tarzi bilan birga o’rganing
— ta’riflar javoblardir.
Atrof-muhit va energetika atamalari
Oldindan ko’rish 1 — Fossil Fuels (noun). Ta’rifni va suhbatdagi misolni ayt-
ing.
Javob. Ta’rif: qadimgi o’simlik va hayvon qoldiqlaridan hosil bo’lgan tabiiy energiya
manbalari (masalan, ko’mir, neft va tabiiy gaz). Ushbu suhbatda: most industrial
manufacturers burn fossil fuels to create high-temperature heat.
Oldindan ko’rish 2 — Carbon Pollution / Emissions (noun). Ta’rifni va suh-
batdagi misolni ayting.
Javob.
Ta’rif: atmosferaga chiqariladigan, issiqlikni ushlab qoladigan va iqlimga
zarar yetkazadigan issiqxona gazlari (asosan CO₂). Ushbu suhbatda: industrial heat
is responsible for roughly 20% of global carbon pollution.
Oldindan ko’rish 3 — Intermittent (adjective). Ta’rifni va suhbatdagi misolni
ayting.
Javob. Ta’rif: uzluksiz bo’lmagan; notekis oraliqlarda to’xtab-qayta boshlanadigan.
Ushbu suhbatda: renewable energy from wind and solar is intermittent because it
depends on the weather (the wind blowing or the sun shining).
5

·
Materiallar va mexanika atamalari
Oldindan ko’rish 4 — Composite (noun). Ta’rifni va suhbatdagi misolni ayt-
ing.
Javob. Ta’rif: yaxshilangan xossali yangi modda olish uchun ikki yoki undan ortiq
alohida elementni birlashtirib tayyorlangan material. Ushbu suhbatda: a nickel and
chromium composite was invented in 1905 to make better heating elements.
Oldindan ko’rish 5 — Filament / Heating Element (noun).
Ta’rifni va suh-
batdagi misolni ayting.
Javob.
Ta’rif: elektr qarshilik tufayli elektr energiyasini issiqlik energiyasiga ay-
lantiruvchi ingichka sim yoki metall bo’lakcha. Ushbu suhbatda: the large storage
bricks are threaded with filaments, just like the ones inside a kitchen toaster.
Oldindan ko’rish 6 — Abundant (adjective). Ta’rifni va suhbatdagi misolni
ayting.
Javob. Ta’rif: katta miqdorda mavjud; mo’l-ko’l va topish oson. Ushbu suhbatda:
materials like bricks, rocks, and molten salt are cheap and abundant, making them
great for storing heat.
Issiqlik va tuzilish atamalari
Oldindan ko’rish 7 — Disperse (verb). Ta’rifni va suhbatdagi misolni ayting.
Javob.
Ta’rif: biror narsani sochib yuborish, keng maydonga tarqatish yoki teng
taqsimlash. Ushbu suhbatda: coiled toaster wires allow heat to be dispersed evenly
across a slice of bread or a structural brick.
Oldindan ko’rish 8 — Encased (adjective/verb). Ta’rifni va suhbatdagi misolni
ayting.
Javob. Ta’rif: himoya idishi yoki tashqi qatlam ichiga to’liq joylashtirilgan, yopilgan
yoki o’ralgan.
Ushbu suhbatda: the entire thermal battery system is encased in
insulating steel.
Oldindan ko’rish 9 — Insulation (noun). Ta’rifni va suhbatdagi misolni ayt-
ing.
Javob.
Ta’rif:
issiqlik, elektr yoki tovushni ushlab qolib, chiqib ketishiga yo’l
qo’ymaydigan material. Ushbu suhbatda: steel insulation ensures that less than 1%
of the heat escapes the battery chamber daily.
Oldindan ko’rish 10 — Channels (noun). Ta’rifni va suhbatdagi misolni ayt-
ing.
Javob. Ta’rif: havo, gaz yoki suyuqlik oqib o’tishi mumkin bo’lgan tor, ochiq yo’laklar
yoki o’tish joylari. Ushbu suhbatda: the interlocking blocks are molded with open
channels so that cold gases can be blown through them to collect the stored heat.
2.2.2 Tezkor tekshiruv: oldindan ko’rish testi
Tinglashdan oldin bo’sh joylarni yuqoridagi lug’atdan olingan so’zlar bilan to’ldiring.
Quick Check 1. Solar power is highly dependent on the weather, making it
an ___ energy source.
Javob. intermittent — uzluksiz bo’lmagan; notekis oraliqlarda to’xtab-qayta bosh-
lanadigan (renewable energy from wind and solar is intermittent because it depends
on the weather).
Quick Check 2. To keep the heat inside the system from escaping into the
factory, the brick chamber must be heavily ___.

ensures that less than 1% of the heat escapes the battery chamber daily).

2.2.3 Asosiy mazmunni tinglash
Har bir savol uchun eng to’g’ri javobni tanlang.
Listening for gist 1.
What is the main topic of this TED-Ed talk?
A) The
history of kitchen appliances and how they changed breakfast. B) Using a
century-old toaster technology to build large-scale heat batteries for indus-
try. C) The process of manufacturing high-quality bricks, rocks, and molten
salt. D) How wind and solar energy can completely replace the electric grid
today.
Javob. B) Using a century-old toaster technology to build large-scale heat batteries
for industry. Suhbat buni tushuntiradi: toaster’ning isitish elementi — 1905-yilda ix-
tiro qilingan nikel va xrom kompoziti — hozir arzon va mo’l-ko’l saqlash g’ishtlari
orasidan o’tkaziladi, shu tufayli oraliq (intermittent) qayta tiklanuvchan energiya
sanoat uchun issiqlik sifatida saqlanadi.
Listening for gist 2. Why is industrial heat a major environmental problem
according to the talk? A) It consumes over 80% of the world’s fresh water
supply. B) It is too expensive for small companies to generate safely. C) Most
companies burn fossil fuels to achieve high temperatures, creating 20% of
global carbon pollution.
D) Industrial factories release too much hot air
directly into the atmosphere, causing global warming.
Javob. C) Most companies burn fossil fuels to achieve high temperatures, creating
20% of global carbon pollution. Lug’atdagi qator buni tasdiqlaydi: industrial heat is
responsible for roughly 20% of global carbon pollution.
2.2.4 1-mashq — to’g’ri shaklni, aktiv yoki passiv, aylana bilan belgilang
To’g’ri shaklni, aktiv yoki passiv, aylana bilan belgilang. Birinchi misol berilgan: The
college built / was built in the 16th century. →was built.
• The costumes for the show are making / are being made by hand.
• The story inspired / was inspired him to make a film.
• This castle hasn’t inhabited / hasn’t been inhabited for nearly a century.
• His latest film set / is set in Vietnam in the 1960s.
• The film will shoot / will be shot in the autumn.
• The actors aren’t recording / aren’t being recorded the dialogue until next week.

• The make-up artist has transformed / has been transformed the actor into a

• They hadn’t owned / hadn’t been owned the company for very long before they

• The photo took / was taken by my husband on the balcony of our hotel.
1-mashq — javoblar kaliti (10 ta).
Javob. (1) are being made; (2) inspired — the story harakatni bajaradi, demak aktiv
to’g’ri; (3) hasn’t been inhabited; (4) is set; (5) will be shot; (6) aren’t recording — the
actors harakatni bajaradi (aktiv); (7) wasn’t being used; (8) has transformed — the
make-up artist harakatni bajaradi (aktiv); (9) hadn’t owned — aktiv; (10) was taken.
Umumiy qoida: ega harakatga duchor bo’lsa va bajaruvchi noma’lum yoki muhim
bo’lmasa, passivni tanlang (1–2-qoidalar); ega harakatni to’ldiruvchiga nisbatan ba-
jaradigan bo’lsa, aktivni saqlang (7-qoida).

Ma’no o’zgarmasligi uchun passiv bilan to’ldiring. by ni faqat zarur bo’lgandagina
ishlating. Birinchi misol berilgan: People don’t use this room very often. →This
room isn’t used very often.

1985.

box office.

script.

2-mashq — javoblar kaliti (10 ta).
Javob. (1) A lot of foreign films are subtitled. (2) Love in the Time of Cholera was
written in 1985. (3) My laptop is being repaired at the moment. (4) The DVD of the
film hasn’t been released yet. (5) The film won’t be finished until the spring. (6)
The tickets have to be collected from the box office. (7) The actor hadn’t been told
about the changes in the script. (8) La La Land was directed by Damien Chazelle. (9)
The soundtrack has already been recorded. (10) The director was being interviewed
about the film. Zamonlarga e’tibor bering: present simple (1), past simple (2, 8),
present continuous (3), present perfect (4, 9), will (5), have to (6), past perfect (7),
past continuous (10). by faqat (8)-misolda zarur — u yerda gapning asosiy nuqtasi
rejissyorning ismi (3-qoida); (2)-misolda yozuvchining ismi kerak emas, chunki gap
kitobga qaratilgan.

2.3.1 1-topshiriq — har bir rasmga tavsifni moslashtiring
Har bir rasmga tavsifni moslashtiring. Ma’ruzadagi o’n ta rasm jarayon nomlari bi-
lan belgilangan (skanerda o’qilgan yozuvlar: bolting, casting, drilling, inspection,
painting, pressing, punching, turning, welding; o’ninchi yozuv 5-tavsifga tegishli).
• A hole is made using a drill.
• A surface is covered with paint.
• A hole is punched in a material.
• The work is checked carefully.
• A surface is polished to make it smooth and shiny.
• A material is pressed into the correct shape.
• Hot liquid material is poured into a container and cooled to make the correct
shape.
• Two pieces are joined together using very high temperature.
• A material is turned on a machine called a lathe. Part of the material is removed
to make the

What is conversion? Conversion means that a word changes its job without changing
its shape. We add no prefix and no suffix. The same word simply starts to work as a
different part of speech. • water (noun): Can I have a glass of water? • water (verb):

to a root: inspect →inspector →inspection. In conversion, we add nothing: an email
→to email. Teachers sometimes call this «zero derivation», because the ending is
zero. Conversion is very common in English. It is one reason why English learners
can use new words quickly: if you know the noun, you can often guess the verb.
